channel.title: Ballard & Fremont Dispatch
channel.description: Ballard & Fremont news, once a week, from the Ballard & Fremont Dispatch.

item.title: Route 40's street work is finished through Ballard and Fremont
item.description: SDOT says major construction is done, with a ribbon cutting on October 29; crews may return for smaller tasks in the coming weeks.

item.title: A rezone at 6400 8th Ave NW would allow a six-story building with about 300 apartments
item.description: The application, filed October 26, asks for a contract rezone of the site from a 40-foot commercial zone and lowrise zoning to a 65-foot limit, for apartments, retail and 274 parking spaces below ground; the existing building would be demolished.

item.title: Ballard light rail's draft environmental study comes out December 11
item.description: Sound Transit opens a public comment period that day, running through February 9, with a hearing at the Nordic Museum on January 12.

item.title: the drain on your corner
item.description: Fallen leaves are the first thing to clog a storm drain, and a clogged drain floods the street around it in a hard rain.
